items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-27
items.q: A guy named Zemo used to run. Great big fellas about six feet five in those days. I couldn't remember him well.

ctx.x: Well, anyway, what was back there where the mortuary is?

All these what they called saloons in those days. A guy named Zemo used to run. Great big fellas about six feet five in those days. I couldn't remember him well. Of course, my daddy frequented those places a lot of times. I had to go and get my daddy out. Time to come home.
Well, he didn't drink, did he?
